meta.note: Fully translated into ko/en/es. Universally relatable topics by design — no Korea-specific cultural elements (holidays, talismans, incantations, etc.).

questions.text_en: Is there someone nearby who's interested in me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay alguien cerca que esté interesado/a en mí?

questions.text_en: Is this a good time for me to start dating?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este un buen momento para empezar a salir con alguien?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 사람에게 매력을 느끼는 편일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of person am I usually drawn to?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de persona suele atraerme?

questions.text_ko: 소개팅이나 새로운 만남이 잘 풀릴 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a good period coming up for a blind date or new meeting?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un buen período por venir para una cita a ciegas o un nuevo encuentro?

questions.text_ko: 나는 사랑에 있어 어떤 실수를 반복하는 편일까?
questions.text_en: What mistake do I tend to repeat in love?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué error tiendo a repetir en el amor?

questions.text_ko: 나와 잘 맞는 사람의 특징은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What traits does someone who's a good match for me have?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué características tiene alguien que sería un buen partido para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 먼저 다가가는 편이 좋을까, 기다리는 편이 좋을까?
questions.text_en: Is it better for me to approach first, or wait?
questions.text_es: ¿Es mejor para mí dar el primer paso, o esperar?

questions.text_ko: 나의 이상형과 실제로 잘 맞는 사람은 다를까?
questions.text_en: Is the person who's actually right for me different from my ideal type?
questions.text_es: ¿Es la persona que realmente me conviene diferente de mi tipo ideal?

questions.text_ko: 온라인에서 만난 인연도 잘 이어질 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can a connection made online actually work out?
questions.text_es: ¿Puede funcionar de verdad una conexión hecha en línea?

questions.text_ko: 나는 연애를 할 때 어떤 점을 가장 중요하게 볼까?

questions.text_es: ¿Qué es lo que más valoro cuando salgo con alguien?

questions.text_en: Is there an age range or personality type that suits me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un rango de edad o tipo de personalidad que me convenga?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 마음에 드는 사람 앞에서 소극적으로 변할까?

questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me vuelvo pasivo/a frente a alguien que me gusta?

questions.text_ko: 지금 내 곁에 좋은 인연이 다가오고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is a good connection approaching me right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Se está acercando una buena conexión a mí en este momento?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 방식으로 사랑을 표현하는 사람일까?
questions.text_en: What's my way of expressing love?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi forma de expresar el amor?

questions.text_ko: 나는 언제쯤 결혼하게 될까?
questions.text_en: When will I get married?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo me voy a casar?

questions.text_ko: 나와 결혼할 사람은 어떤 사람일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of person will I marry?
questions.text_es: ¿Con qué tipo de persona me voy a casar?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼 생활에서 어떤 점을 중요하게 여길까?
questions.text_en: What will matter most to me in married life?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué será lo más importante para mí en la vida matrimonial?

questions.text_ko: 결혼 상대는 나와 성격이 비슷할까, 다를까?
questions.text_en: Will my spouse have a similar personality to mine, or a different one?
questions.text_es: ¿Tendrá mi pareja una personalidad similar a la mía, o diferente?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼을 서두르는 게 좋을까, 천천히 하는 게 좋을까?
questions.text_en: Should I rush into marriage, or take it slow?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería apresurarme a casarme, o tomarlo con calma?

questions.text_ko: 나의 결혼 생활은 안정적일까?
questions.text_en: Will my married life be stable?
questions.text_es: ¿Será estable mi vida matrimonial?

questions.text_ko: 나는 배우자와 오래도록 좋은 관계를 유지할 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I maintain a good relationship with my spouse long-term?
questions.text_es: ¿Podré mantener una buena relación con mi pareja a largo plazo?

questions.text_ko: 결혼 상대를 이미 알고 지내는 사이일 수도 있을까?
questions.text_en: Could I already know the person I'll marry?
questions.text_es: ¿Podría ya conocer a la persona con la que me voy a casar?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 결혼하기 좋은 시기는 언제일까?
questions.text_en: When's a good time for me to get married?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo es un buen momento para que me case?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼 후에도 지금의 목표를 이어갈 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I keep pursuing my current goals even after marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Podré seguir persiguiendo mis metas actuales incluso después de casarme?

questions.text_ko: 나의 배우자는 나에게 어떤 존재가 되어줄까?
questions.text_en: What will my spouse become to me?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué llegará a ser mi pareja para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼을 앞두고 무엇을 준비해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I prepare for before getting married?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué debería preparar antes de casarme?

questions.text_ko: 청혼을 받게 된다면 그 시기는 언제쯤일까?
questions.text_en: If I get a proposal, around when might that be?
questions.text_es: Si recibo una propuesta de matrimonio, ¿aproximadamente cuándo sería?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼 후 지금 사는 곳에서 계속 살게 될까?
questions.text_en: Will I keep living where I live now after marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Seguiré viviendo donde vivo ahora después de casarme?

questions.text_ko: 나와 배우자는 경제적으로 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: Will my spouse and I be financially compatible?
questions.text_es: ¿Seremos mi pareja y yo compatibles económicamente?

questions.text_ko: 나의 결혼 생활에서 가장 큰 어려움은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What will be the biggest challenge in my married life?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál será el mayor desafío en mi vida matrimonial?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼을 통해 어떤 변화를 겪게 될까?
questions.text_en: What changes will I go through because of marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué cambios experimentaré por el matrimonio?

questions.text_ko: 지금 만나는 사람과 결혼까지 이어질 가능성이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a chance my current relationship leads to marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una posibilidad de que mi relación actual lleve al matrimonio?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 잘 맞는 결혼 상대의 나이대나 배경이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there an age range or background that suits my future spouse?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un rango de edad o trasfondo que le convenga a mi futuro/a cónyuge?

questions.text_ko: 나는 나중에 배우자와 어떤 모습으로 살아가게 될까?
questions.text_en: What will my life with my spouse look like later on?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo se verá mi vida con mi pareja más adelante?

questions.text_ko: 지금 만나는 사람과 나는 얼마나 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: How compatible am I with the person I'm seeing now?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tan compatible soy con la persona que estoy conociendo ahora?

questions.text_ko: 이 관계는 앞으로 더 좋아질까?
questions.text_en: Will this relationship keep getting better?
questions.text_es: ¿Seguirá mejorando esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 지금 상대방은 나를 진심으로 생각하고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Does this person truly care about me?
questions.text_es: ¿Le importo de verdad a esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 우리 사이에 곧 중요한 변화가 생길까?
questions.text_en: Will an important change happen between us soon?
questions.text_es: ¿Ocurrirá pronto un cambio importante entre nosotros?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 관계에서 무엇을 놓치고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What am I missing in this relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué me estoy perdiendo en esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 우리가 자주 다투는 이유는 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: Why do we argue so often?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué discutimos tan seguido?

questions.text_ko: 지금 관계를 더 발전시키려면 무엇이 필요할까?
questions.text_en: What do we need to take this relationship further?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué necesitamos para llevar esta relación más lejos?

questions.text_ko: 상대방과 나는 서로에게 얼마나 솔직할까?
questions.text_en: How honest are we with each other?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tan honestos somos el uno con el otro?

questions.text_ko: 우리 관계가 힘든 시기를 지나고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Is our relationship going through a rough patch?
questions.text_es: ¿Está pasando nuestra relación por un momento difícil?

questions.text_ko: 지금 상대와 계속 만나는 게 맞는 선택일까?
questions.text_en: Is staying with this person the right choice?
questions.text_es: ¿Es quedarme con esta persona la decisión correcta?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 관계에서 너무 많이 맞추고 있는 건 아닐까?
questions.text_en: Am I compromising too much in this relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy cediendo demasiado en esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 상대방의 진심을 확인하고 싶은데 방법이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a way to find out their true feelings?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una forma de descubrir sus verdaderos sentimientos?

questions.text_ko: 지금 연인과 나는 가치관이 잘 맞는 편일까?
questions.text_en: Do my partner and I share similar values?
questions.text_es: ¿Compartimos mi pareja y yo valores similares?

questions.text_ko: 우리 관계에서 내가 놓치고 있는 신호가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a sign in this relationship I'm missing?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una señal en esta relación que se me esté escapando?

questions.text_ko: 상대방과 함께 있을 때 나는 나답게 지내고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I being myself when I'm with them?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy siendo yo mismo/a cuando estoy con esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 이 사람과 미래를 그려도 괜찮을까?
questions.text_en: Is it okay to picture a future with this person?
questions.text_es: ¿Está bien imaginar un futuro con esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 지금 관계에서 내가 더 노력해야 할 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something I should be trying harder at in this relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo en lo que debería esforzarme más en esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 우리 사이에 신뢰가 충분히 쌓여 있을까?
questions.text_en: Have we built enough trust between us?
questions.text_es: ¿Hemos construido suficiente confianza entre nosotros?

questions.text_ko: 상대방이 나에게 서운함을 느끼고 있진 않을까?
questions.text_en: Could they be feeling hurt by me?
questions.text_es: ¿Podría sentirse esta persona dolida por mí?

questions.text_ko: 이 관계가 나에게 정말 좋은 영향을 주고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is this relationship really having a good effect on me?
questions.text_es: ¿Está teniendo esta relación un efecto realmente bueno en mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 자꾸 지난 관계를 되돌아보게 될까?
questions.text_en: Why do I keep looking back on this past relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué sigo mirando atrás a esta relación pasada?

questions.text_ko: 새로운 사람을 만날 준비가 되었을까?
questions.text_en: Am I ready to meet someone new?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy listo/a para conocer a alguien nuevo?

questions.text_ko: 그 사람과의 인연은 여기서 끝난 걸까?
questions.text_en: Is my connection with this person over for good?
questions.text_es: ¿Se acabó para siempre mi conexión con esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이별 후 나 자신을 어떻게 돌봐야 할까?
questions.text_en: How should I take care of myself after this breakup?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo debería cuidarme después de esta ruptura?

questions.text_ko: 전 연인에게 미련이 남아 있는 건 아닐까?
questions.text_en: Do I still have lingering feelings for my ex?
questions.text_es: ¿Todavía tengo sentimientos pendientes por mi ex?

questions.text_ko: 이 이별은 나에게 어떤 의미가 있을까?
questions.text_en: What does this breakup mean for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué significa esta ruptura para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 같은 실수를 반복하지 않을 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I avoid repeating the same mistake?
questions.text_es: ¿Puedo evitar repetir el mismo error?

questions.text_ko: 시간이 지나면 이 관계를 어떻게 기억하게 될까?
questions.text_en: How will I remember this relationship once time has passed?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo recordaré esta relación cuando pase el tiempo?

questions.text_ko: 나의 사주에서 돈은 어떤 방식으로 들어올까?
questions.text_en: In what way does money tend to come to me, according to my saju?
questions.text_es: ¿De qué forma tiende a llegarme el dinero, según mi saju?

questions.text_ko: 나는 돈 관리를 잘하는 편일까?
questions.text_en: Am I good at managing money?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me da bien manejar el dinero?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 재물운이 강하게 들어오는 시기는 언제일까?
questions.text_en: When is a period of strong financial luck coming for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo llega un período de suerte financiera fuerte para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 돈이 모이는 만큼 빠져나가는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Why does money seem to leave as fast as it comes in?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué el dinero parece irse tan rápido como llega?

questions.text_ko: 나의 재물운은 노력과 얼마나 비례할까?
questions.text_en: How much does my financial luck depend on my own effort?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánto depende mi suerte financiera de mi propio esfuerzo?

questions.text_ko: 갑자기 큰돈이 생길 가능성이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a chance a large sum of money comes to me suddenly?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una posibilidad de que me llegue de repente una gran cantidad de dinero?

questions.text_ko: 나는 저축과 소비 중 어느 쪽에 더 신경 써야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I focus more on saving, or on spending?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería enfocarme más en ahorrar, o en gastar?

questions.text_ko: 나의 경제적 안정은 언제쯤 찾아올까?
questions.text_en: When will financial stability arrive for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo llegará la estabilidad financiera para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 돈에 대해 어떤 태도를 갖고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What kind of attitude do I have toward money?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de actitud tengo hacia el dinero?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 숨겨진 재물운이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there hidden financial luck in my chart?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay suerte financiera oculta en mi carta?

questions.text_ko: 나는 돈 때문에 스트레스를 받는 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period when money causes me a lot of stress?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período en el que el dinero me causa mucho estrés?

questions.text_ko: 나의 씀씀이는 사주와 어떤 관련이 있을까?
questions.text_en: How is my spending connected to my saju?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo se relaciona mi forma de gastar con mi saju?

questions.text_ko: 나는 부수입을 만들기에 유리한 사주일까?
questions.text_en: Is my saju favorable for building a side income?
questions.text_es: ¿Es mi saju favorable para generar un ingreso adicional?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 경제적으로 도움을 주는 인연이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there someone who will help me financially?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay alguien que me ayudará económicamente?

questions.text_ko: 나는 돈을 빌려주거나 빌리는 것에 조심해야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I be careful about lending or borrowing money?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería tener cuidado al prestar o pedir dinero prestado?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나의 재물운 흐름은 어떨까?
questions.text_en: How is the flow of my financial luck this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo es el flujo de mi suerte financiera este año?

questions.text_ko: 나는 물질적 풍요와 마음의 만족 중 무엇이 더 중요한 사람일까?
questions.text_en: Which matters more to me — material comfort, or peace of mind?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué me importa más: la comodidad material, o la tranquilidad mental?

questions.text_ko: 나의 소비 습관에서 고쳐야 할 점이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something I should fix about my spending habits?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo que debería corregir en mis hábitos de gasto?

questions.text_ko: 나는 돈 문제로 인간관계에서 갈등을 겪게 될까?
questions.text_en: Will money cause conflict in my relationships?
questions.text_es: ¿Causará el dinero conflictos en mis relaciones?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 재물이 들어오는 통로는 일인지, 다른 무엇인지 궁금해.
questions.text_en: I'm curious whether money mainly comes to me through work, or some other path.
questions.text_es: Tengo curiosidad de si el dinero me llega principalmente a través del trabajo, o de algún otro camino.

questions.text_ko: 지금이 나에게 투자하기 좋은 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Is now a good time for me to invest?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este un buen momento para que invierta?

questions.text_ko: 나는 투자에서 신중한 편이 좋을까, 과감한 편이 좋을까?
questions.text_en: Am I better suited to cautious investing, or bold investing?
questions.text_es: ¿Me conviene más invertir con cautela, o de forma audaz?

questions.text_ko: 나의 사주는 안정적인 투자와 공격적인 투자 중 무엇이 더 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: Does my saju favor stable investments, or aggressive ones?
questions.text_es: ¿Favorece mi saju las inversiones estables, o las agresivas?

questions.text_ko: 나는 큰 결정을 내리기 전에 무엇을 조심해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I be careful of before making a big decision?
questions.text_es: ¿De qué debería tener cuidado antes de tomar una decisión importante?

questions.text_ko: 부동산과 관련된 좋은 기회가 나에게 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a good real-estate opportunity coming my way?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me acerca una buena oportunidad inmobiliaria?

questions.text_ko: 나는 돈을 불리는 데 재능이 있는 사주일까?
questions.text_en: Does my saju suggest I have a talent for growing money?
questions.text_es: ¿Sugiere mi saju que tengo talento para hacer crecer el dinero?

questions.text_ko: 지금 계획 중인 재정적 결정을 미루는 게 나을까?
questions.text_en: Should I hold off on the financial decision I'm currently planning?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería posponer la decisión financiera que estoy planeando ahora?

questions.text_ko: 나는 다른 사람의 조언을 얼마나 신뢰해야 할까?
questions.text_en: How much should I trust other people's advice?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánto debería confiar en el consejo de otras personas?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 금전적으로 위험한 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a financially risky period ahead for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período financieramente riesgoso por delante para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 장기적인 계획과 단기적인 기회 중 어디에 집중해야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I focus on long-term plans, or short-term opportunities?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería enfocarme en planes a largo plazo, o en oportunidades a corto plazo?

questions.text_ko: 나의 사주에서 투자운이 특히 강한 분야가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a field where my investment luck is especially strong?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un campo donde mi suerte de inversión es especialmente fuerte?

questions.text_ko: 지금처럼 저축하는 방식이 나에게 맞는 방법일까?
questions.text_en: Is saving the way I currently do it the right approach for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Es ahorrar de la forma en que lo hago ahora el enfoque correcto para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 동업이나 공동 투자에 유리한 사주일까?
questions.text_en: Does my saju favor partnerships or joint investments?
questions.text_es: ¿Favorece mi saju las sociedades o las inversiones conjuntas?

questions.text_ko: 큰돈을 다룰 때 나는 어떤 점을 특히 조심해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I be especially careful about when handling large sums of money?
questions.text_es: ¿De qué debería tener especial cuidado al manejar grandes sumas de dinero?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 예상치 못한 재정적 기회가 찾아올까?
questions.text_en: Will an unexpected financial opportunity come my way?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me presentará una oportunidad financiera inesperada?

questions.text_ko: 나는 빚을 지는 것에 대해 얼마나 신중해야 할까?
questions.text_en: How cautious should I be about taking on debt?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tan cauteloso/a debería ser respecto a endeudarme?

questions.text_ko: 지금의 경제적 결정이 몇 년 뒤 어떤 결과로 이어질까?
questions.text_en: Where will today's financial decisions lead a few years from now?
questions.text_es: ¿A dónde llevarán las decisiones financieras de hoy dentro de unos años?

questions.text_ko: 나는 여러 수입원을 만드는 데 유리한 편일까?
questions.text_en: Am I well-suited to building multiple income streams?
questions.text_es: ¿Tengo facilidad para generar múltiples fuentes de ingreso?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 금전적으로 조언을 구해도 좋은 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a good time for me to seek financial advice?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un buen momento para que busque consejo financiero?

questions.text_ko: 나의 재테크 방식은 나의 성향과 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: Does my approach to building wealth suit my personality?
questions.text_es: ¿Se ajusta mi forma de generar riqueza a mi personalidad?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 인생을 바꿀 만한 기회가 다가오고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is a life-changing opportunity approaching me?
questions.text_es: ¿Se está acercando a mí una oportunidad que puede cambiarme la vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 큰 기회를 알아볼 준비가 되어 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I ready to recognize a big opportunity when it comes?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy listo/a para reconocer una gran oportunidad cuando llegue?

questions.text_ko: 지금 이 선택이 나에게 좋은 전환점이 될까?
questions.text_en: Could this choice become an important turning point for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Podría convertirse esta decisión en un punto de inflexión importante para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 예상치 못한 행운이 찾아올 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period ahead when unexpected good luck comes my way?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período por delante en el que me llegue buena suerte inesperada?

questions.text_ko: 나는 기회를 놓치지 않으려면 무엇을 준비해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I prepare so I don't miss my opportunity?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué debería preparar para no dejar pasar mi oportunidad?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인생에서 가장 중요한 전환점은 언제였을까, 혹은 언제일까?
questions.text_en: What was — or will be — the most important turning point in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál fue, o será, el punto de inflexión más importante en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 안주하고 있는 걸까, 도전해야 할 때일까?
questions.text_en: Am I getting too comfortable right now, or is it time to take a risk?
questions.text_es: ¿Me estoy acomodando demasiado ahora mismo, o es hora de arriesgarme?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 찾아온 이 기회를 잡아야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I take this opportunity that's come my way?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería aprovechar esta oportunidad que se me ha presentado?

questions.text_ko: 나는 위험을 감수할 준비가 된 사주일까?
questions.text_en: Does my saju show I'm ready to take on risk?
questions.text_es: ¿Muestra mi saju que estoy listo/a para asumir riesgos?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인생에서 반복되는 패턴이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a pattern that keeps repeating in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un patrón que se repite constantemente en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금보다 더 큰 무대로 나아갈 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I move on to a bigger stage than where I am now?
questions.text_es: ¿Puedo pasar a un escenario más grande que el actual?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 뜻밖의 좋은 소식이 찾아올 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period ahead when unexpectedly good news comes my way?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período por delante en el que me llegue una noticia inesperadamente buena?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 노력이 언제쯤 결실을 맺게 될까?
questions.text_en: When will my current effort finally pay off?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo dará frutos por fin mi esfuerzo actual?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인생 전체를 놓고 봤을 때 지금은 어떤 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Looking at my life as a whole, what kind of period is this right now?
questions.text_es: Mirando mi vida en su conjunto, ¿qué tipo de período es este ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 남들보다 늦게 빛을 보는 사주일까, 일찍 빛을 보는 사주일까?
questions.text_en: Does my saju suggest I'll find success later in life, or earlier?
questions.text_es: ¿Sugiere mi saju que voy a encontrar el éxito más tarde en la vida, o más temprano?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 결정적인 도움을 줄 사람이 나타날까?
questions.text_en: Will someone appear who gives me decisive help?
questions.text_es: ¿Aparecerá alguien que me dé una ayuda decisiva?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 어려움을 통해 무엇을 얻게 될까?
questions.text_en: What will I gain from the difficulty I'm going through right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué voy a ganar de la dificultad que estoy atravesando ahora?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인생에서 가장 풍요로운 시기는 언제일까?
questions.text_en: When will be the most abundant period of my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo será el período más próspero de mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 기회가 왔을 때 망설이는 편일까, 바로 잡는 편일까?
questions.text_en: Do I tend to hesitate when an opportunity comes, or seize it right away?
questions.text_es: ¿Tiendo a dudar cuando llega una oportunidad, o a aprovecharla de inmediato?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 새로운 문이 열리는 시기가 다가오고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is a period when new doors open for me approaching?
questions.text_es: ¿Se acerca un período en el que se me abran nuevas puertas?

questions.text_ko: 지금 하는 일이 나에게 정말 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: Is what I'm doing now really the right fit for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Es lo que estoy haciendo ahora realmente lo que me conviene?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 직장에서 인정받고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I being recognized at my current job?
questions.text_es: ¿Me están reconociendo en mi trabajo actual?

questions.text_ko: 나의 사주는 지금 업무 방식과 얼마나 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: How well does my saju match my current way of working?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tan bien encaja mi saju con mi forma actual de trabajar?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 자리에서 얼마나 더 성장할 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: How much more can I grow in my current position?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánto más puedo crecer en mi posición actual?

questions.text_ko: 지금 하는 일에서 느끼는 답답함의 이유가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a reason behind the frustration I feel in my current job?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una razón detrás de la frustración que siento en mi trabajo actual?

questions.text_ko: 나는 동료들과의 관계에서 어떤 포지션에 있을까?
questions.text_en: Where do I stand in my relationships with coworkers?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi posición en mis relaciones con mis compañeros de trabajo?

questions.text_ko: 나의 능력을 지금보다 더 인정받을 방법이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a way to get more recognition for my abilities?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una forma de obtener más reconocimiento por mis habilidades?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 일에 최선을 다하고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Am I really giving my current job my best effort?
questions.text_es: ¿Le estoy dando de verdad lo mejor de mí a mi trabajo actual?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 지금 필요한 건 변화일까, 인내일까?
questions.text_en: Do I need a change right now, or more patience?
questions.text_es: ¿Necesito un cambio ahora mismo, o más paciencia?

questions.text_ko: 나는 상사와의 관계에서 무엇을 조심해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I be careful about in my relationship with my boss?
questions.text_es: ¿De qué debería tener cuidado en mi relación con mi jefe?

questions.text_ko: 지금 이 일을 계속하는 게 나에게 맞는 선택일까?
questions.text_en: Is continuing with this job the right choice for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Es seguir con este trabajo la decisión correcta para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나의 능력이 가장 잘 발휘되는 환경은 어떤 곳일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of environment brings out my abilities the best?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de ambiente saca lo mejor de mis habilidades?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 하는 일에서 번아웃이 올 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period of burnout ahead for me in my current job?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período de agotamiento por delante para mí en mi trabajo actual?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 승진이나 좋은 평가가 다가오고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is a promotion or good evaluation coming my way?
questions.text_es: ¿Se acerca un ascenso o una buena evaluación para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 일에서 무엇을 더 배워야 할까?
questions.text_en: What do I still need to learn from my current job?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué me falta por aprender de mi trabajo actual?

questions.text_ko: 나의 직장 생활에서 반복되는 어려움이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a recurring difficulty in my work life?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una dificultad recurrente en mi vida laboral?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 조직에 계속 남아야 할까, 떠나야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I stay with my current organization, or leave?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería quedarme en mi organización actual, o irme?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 지금 필요한 동료나 인맥이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a colleague or connection I need right now?

questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de personalidad tendrá mi hijo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나는 자녀와 어떤 관계를 맺게 될까?
questions.text_en: What kind of relationship will I build with my child?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de relación construiré con mi hijo/a?

questions.text_ko: 자녀 계획을 세우기에 지금이 좋은 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Is now a good time to plan for having children?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este un buen momento para planear tener hijos?

questions.text_ko: 나는 자녀에게 어떤 부모로 기억될까?
questions.text_en: How will my child remember me as a parent?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo me recordará mi hijo/a como padre/madre?

questions.text_ko: 나의 자녀는 어떤 분야에 재능을 보일까?
questions.text_en: In what field will my child show talent?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué campo mostrará talento mi hijo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나는 육아와 나의 삶 사이에서 균형을 잘 맞출 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Will I be able to balance parenting well with my own life?
questions.text_es: ¿Podré equilibrar bien la crianza con mi propia vida?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 자녀와 관련된 걱정거리가 해소될 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period when my worries about my child will ease?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período en el que se aliviarán mis preocupaciones sobre mi hijo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나는 자녀에게 무엇을 물려주고 싶어 할까?
questions.text_en: What do I want to pass on to my child?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué quiero transmitirle a mi hijo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나의 자녀는 나와 얼마나 비슷하거나 다를까?
questions.text_en: How similar or different will my child be from me?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tan parecido o diferente será mi hijo/a de mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 다음 세대에게 어떤 가치를 전해주고 싶을까?
questions.text_en: What values do I want to pass on to the next generation?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué valores quiero transmitirle a la próxima generación?

questions.text_ko: 자녀와의 관계에서 내가 신경 써야 할 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something I should pay attention to in my relationship with my child?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo a lo que debería prestar atención en mi relación con mi hijo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나는 부모가 되는 것에 대해 어떤 마음의 준비가 필요할까?
questions.text_en: What kind of mental preparation do I need for becoming a parent?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de preparación mental necesito para convertirme en padre/madre?

questions.text_ko: 나의 자녀는 앞으로 어떤 삶을 살게 될까?
questions.text_en: What kind of life will my child go on to live?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de vida llegará a vivir mi hijo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나는 자녀 교육에 있어 어떤 방식이 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: What approach to raising my child would suit me?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué enfoque de crianza me convendría?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 조카나 다음 세대와의 특별한 인연이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Do I have a special connection with a niece, nephew, or the next generation?
questions.text_es: ¿Tengo una conexión especial con un sobrino/a o con la próxima generación?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족을 이루는 것에 대해 어떤 마음을 갖고 있을까?
questions.text_en: How do I feel about starting a family?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo me siento respecto a formar una familia?

questions.text_ko: 나의 삶에서 다음 세대를 향한 역할은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What role am I meant to play toward the next generation in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué papel estoy destinado/a a jugar hacia la próxima generación en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 형제자매와 왜 이렇게 다를까?
questions.text_en: Why am I so different from my siblings?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué soy tan diferente de mis hermanos?

questions.text_ko: 형제자매와의 관계는 앞으로 어떻게 흘러갈까?
questions.text_en: How will my relationship with my siblings develop going forward?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo se desarrollará mi relación con mis hermanos de aquí en adelante?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족 안에서 어떤 역할을 맡고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What role do I play within my family?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué papel juego dentro de mi familia?

questions.text_ko: 나는 형제자매에게 서운함을 느끼고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Am I feeling hurt by my siblings?
questions.text_es: ¿Me siento dolido/a por mis hermanos?

questions.text_ko: 가족 모임에서 나는 어떤 존재일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of presence am I at family gatherings?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de presencia tengo en las reuniones familiares?

questions.text_ko: 나는 친척들과의 관계에서 거리를 두는 게 나을까?
questions.text_en: Would it be better for me to keep some distance from my relatives?
questions.text_es: ¿Sería mejor para mí mantener cierta distancia de mis familiares?

questions.text_ko: 형제자매와 다시 가까워질 방법이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a way to grow close to my siblings again?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una forma de volver a acercarme a mis hermanos?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족 중 누구와 가장 잘 통할까?
questions.text_en: Who in my family do I get along with best?
questions.text_es: ¿Con quién de mi familia me llevo mejor?

questions.text_ko: 나의 가족 안에서 반복되는 갈등의 원인은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's the cause of the conflict that keeps repeating in my family?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es la causa del conflicto que se repite en mi familia?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족에게 얼마나 의지해도 될까?
questions.text_en: How much can I rely on my family?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánto puedo depender de mi familia?

questions.text_ko: 형제자매와 나 사이에 경쟁심이 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Is there rivalry between my siblings and me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay rivalidad entre mis hermanos y yo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족의 기대와 나의 삶 사이에서 균형을 잡고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I balancing my family's expectations with my own life?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy equilibrando las expectativas de mi familia con mi propia vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어린 시절 가족 안에서 어떤 영향을 받았을까?
questions.text_en: How was I shaped by my family growing up?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo me formó mi familia mientras crecía?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 힘이 되어주는 가족 구성원이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a family member who's a source of strength for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un familiar que sea una fuente de fortaleza para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족 행사나 모임을 어떻게 대해야 할까?
questions.text_en: How should I approach family events or gatherings?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo debería abordar los eventos o reuniones familiares?

questions.text_ko: 나의 가족 관계는 나의 다른 관계에 어떤 영향을 줄까?
questions.text_en: How does my family relationship affect my other relationships?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo afecta mi relación familiar a mis otras relaciones?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족 중 누군가를 책임져야 하는 상황이 올까?
questions.text_en: Will a situation come up where I need to take responsibility for someone in my family?
questions.text_es: ¿Se presentará una situación en la que necesite hacerme responsable de alguien en mi familia?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족과 다른 삶의 방향을 선택해도 괜찮을까?
questions.text_en: Is it okay for me to choose a different path in life from my family?
questions.text_es: ¿Está bien que elija un camino diferente en la vida al de mi familia?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 가족과 관련된 중요한 변화가 다가오고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is an important family-related change approaching me?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me acerca un cambio importante relacionado con la familia?

questions.text_ko: 나는 가족 안에서 더 솔직해져도 괜찮을까?
questions.text_en: Is it okay for me to be more honest within my family?
questions.text_es: ¿Está bien que sea más honesto/a dentro de mi familia?

questions.text_ko: 나는 진짜 친구를 알아보는 눈이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Do I have a good eye for recognizing real friends?
questions.text_es: ¿Tengo buen ojo para reconocer a los amigos verdaderos?

questions.text_ko: 지금 친구 관계에서 내가 놓치고 있는 게 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something I'm missing in my current friendships?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo que se me esté escapando en mis amistades actuales?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 특정 사람들과 자꾸 부딪히게 될까?
questions.text_en: Why do I keep clashing with certain people?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué sigo chocando con ciertas personas?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 힘이 되어줄 새로운 인연이 나타날까?
questions.text_en: Will a new connection appear that becomes a source of strength for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Aparecerá una nueva conexión que se convierta en una fuente de fortaleza para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 모임에서 어떤 역할을 맡게 되는 편일까?
questions.text_en: What role do I tend to take on in group settings?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué papel tiendo a asumir en entornos grupales?

questions.text_ko: 지금의 친구 관계는 나에게 좋은 영향을 주고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is my current circle of friends having a good effect on me?
questions.text_es: ¿Está teniendo mi círculo de amigos actual un buen efecto en mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 관계마다 다른 내가 되는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Why do I become a different person in each relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me convierto en una persona diferente en cada relación?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 신뢰할 수 있는 사람을 알아보는 안목이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Do I have good judgment for recognizing who I can trust?
questions.text_es: ¿Tengo buen criterio para reconocer en quién puedo confiar?

questions.text_ko: 나는 인간관계에서 너무 많이 맞춰주고 있는 건 아닐까?
questions.text_en: Am I compromising too much in my relationships?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy cediendo demasiado en mis relaciones?

questions.text_ko: 나와 잘 맞는 사람들은 어떤 특징을 가지고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What traits do the people I get along well with tend to share?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué características suelen compartir las personas con las que me llevo bien?

questions.text_ko: 나는 관계를 오래 유지하는 편일까, 쉽게 정리하는 편일까?
questions.text_en: Do I tend to keep relationships for a long time, or let go of them easily?
questions.text_es: ¿Tiendo a mantener las relaciones por mucho tiempo, o a dejarlas ir con facilidad?

questions.text_ko: 지금 멀어진 친구와 다시 가까워질 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I grow close again with a friend I've drifted from?
questions.text_es: ¿Puedo volver a acercarme a un amigo/a del que me he distanciado?

questions.text_ko: 나는 나에게 좋은 영향을 주지 않는 관계를 정리해야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I let go of a relationship that isn't good for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería dejar ir una relación que no me hace bien?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 중요한 인맥을 만날 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period coming when I'll meet an important connection?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período por venir en el que conozca una conexión importante?

questions.text_ko: 나는 사람들 앞에서 나답게 지내고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I being myself around other people?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy siendo yo mismo/a frente a otras personas?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인간관계에서 반복되는 패턴이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a pattern that keeps repeating in my relationships?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un patrón que se repite en mis relaciones?

questions.text_ko: 나는 새로운 환경에서 좋은 사람들을 만날 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Will I be able to meet good people in a new environment?
questions.text_es: ¿Podré conocer buenas personas en un ambiente nuevo?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 도움을 줄 귀인이 나타날 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period when a helpful benefactor will appear for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período en el que aparecerá para mí un benefactor útil?

questions.text_ko: 나는 갈등이 생겼을 때 어떻게 대처하는 게 좋을까?
questions.text_en: How should I handle it when conflict comes up?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo debería manejarlo cuando surge un conflicto?

questions.text_ko: 나의 사교성은 어떤 방식으로 발휘될 때 가장 좋을까?
questions.text_en: In what way does my sociability come across best?
questions.text_es: ¿De qué forma se muestra mejor mi sociabilidad?

questions.text_ko: 나는 정말 어떤 사람일까?
questions.text_en: Who am I, really?
questions.text_es: ¿Quién soy yo, realmente?

questions.text_ko: 나도 몰랐던 나의 성격이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a side of my personality I didn't know about?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un lado de mi personalidad que no conocía?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 특정 상황에서 유독 예민해질까?
questions.text_en: Why do I become especially sensitive in certain situations?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me vuelvo especialmente sensible en ciertas situaciones?

questions.text_ko: 나의 진짜 강점은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's my real strength?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi verdadera fortaleza?

questions.text_ko: 나는 겉모습과 속마음이 얼마나 다를까?
questions.text_en: How different are my outward appearance and my inner feelings?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tan diferentes son mi apariencia externa y mis sentimientos internos?

questions.text_ko: 나는 스트레스를 받을 때 어떤 방식으로 반응할까?
questions.text_en: How do I tend to react when I'm stressed?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo tiendo a reaccionar cuando estoy estresado/a?

questions.text_ko: 나의 성격 중 고쳐야 할 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a part of my personality I should work on?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una parte de mi personalidad que debería trabajar?

questions.text_ko: 나는 사람들에게 어떤 인상을 주는 편일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of impression do I tend to give people?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de impresión tiendo a darle a la gente?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 이런 성격을 갖게 되었을까?
questions.text_en: Why did I end up with this personality?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué terminé con esta personalidad?

questions.text_ko: 나의 성격은 나이가 들면서 어떻게 변할까?
questions.text_en: How will my personality change as I get older?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo cambiará mi personalidad a medida que envejezco?

questions.text_ko: 나는 감정을 표현하는 데 서툰 편일까?
questions.text_en: Am I not very good at expressing my emotions?
questions.text_es: ¿No se me da muy bien expresar mis emociones?

questions.text_ko: 나의 진짜 매력은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's my real charm?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi verdadero encanto?

questions.text_ko: 나는 혼자 있는 시간과 함께 있는 시간 중 무엇이 더 필요할까?
questions.text_en: Which do I need more — time alone, or time with others?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué necesito más: tiempo a solas, o tiempo con otros?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 완벽주의적인 성향을 갖게 되었을까?
questions.text_en: Why did I develop such a perfectionist tendency?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué desarrollé una tendencia tan perfeccionista?

questions.text_ko: 나의 성격 중 남들이 오해하는 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a part of my personality that people tend to misunderstand?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una parte de mi personalidad que la gente suele malinterpretar?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결정을 내릴 때 감정과 이성 중 무엇을 더 따를까?
questions.text_en: When making a decision, do I follow my emotions more, or my reason?
questions.text_es: Al tomar una decisión, ¿sigo más mis emociones, o mi razón?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 사람들 앞에서 가면을 쓰게 될까?
questions.text_en: Why do I end up wearing a mask in front of people?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué termino usando una máscara frente a la gente?

questions.text_ko: 나의 성격은 어떤 환경에서 가장 잘 발휘될까?
questions.text_en: In what environment does my personality shine the most?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué ambiente brilla más mi personalidad?

questions.text_ko: 나는 나 자신을 얼마나 잘 알고 있을까?
questions.text_en: How well do I really know myself?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tan bien me conozco realmente a mí mismo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나의 타고난 기질은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's my innate temperament?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi temperamento innato?

questions.text_ko: 나의 숨겨진 재능은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's my hidden talent?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi talento oculto?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 일을 할 때 가장 나답다고 느낄까?
questions.text_en: When do I feel most like myself?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo me siento más yo mismo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나의 가장 큰 약점은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's my biggest weakness?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi mayor debilidad?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 약점을 어떻게 극복할 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: How can I overcome this weakness?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo puedo superar esta debilidad?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 잘 맞는 환경은 어떤 곳일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of environment suits me well?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de ambiente me conviene bien?

questions.text_ko: 나는 다른 사람보다 유독 뛰어난 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something I'm noticeably better at than other people?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo en lo que soy notablemente mejor que otras personas?

questions.text_ko: 나의 강점을 지금 제대로 활용하고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I making good use of my strengths right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy aprovechando bien mis fortalezas ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 자꾸 같은 실수를 반복하게 될까?
questions.text_en: Why do I keep making the same mistake?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué sigo cometiendo el mismo error?

questions.text_ko: 나의 잠재력은 어디에서 발휘될까?
questions.text_en: Where will my potential come through?
questions.text_es: ¿Dónde se manifestará mi potencial?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 분야에서 두각을 나타낼 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: In what field could I stand out?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué campo podría destacar?

questions.text_ko: 나의 약점이 오히려 강점이 될 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Could my weakness actually become a strength?
questions.text_es: ¿Podría mi debilidad convertirse en realidad en una fortaleza?

questions.text_ko: 나는 나 자신을 과소평가하고 있는 건 아닐까?
questions.text_en: Am I underestimating myself?
questions.text_es: ¿Me estoy subestimando a mí mismo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나의 재능을 알아봐 줄 사람이 나타날까?
questions.text_en: Will someone appear who recognizes my talent?
questions.text_es: ¿Aparecerá alguien que reconozca mi talento?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 상황에서 가장 흔들리는 편일까?
questions.text_en: In what situations am I most likely to waver?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué situaciones es más probable que titubee?

questions.text_ko: 나의 강점을 살릴 수 있는 방향은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What direction would let me make the most of my strengths?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué dirección me permitiría aprovechar al máximo mis fortalezas?

questions.text_ko: 나는 완벽하지 않아도 괜찮은 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something it's okay for me not to be perfect at?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo en lo que está bien que no sea perfecto/a?

questions.text_ko: 나의 능력을 지금보다 더 키우려면 무엇이 필요할까?
questions.text_en: What do I need to develop my abilities further?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué necesito para desarrollar más mis habilidades?

questions.text_ko: 나는 실패를 통해 무엇을 배우는 사람일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of person am I when I learn from failure?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de persona soy cuando aprendo del fracaso?

questions.text_ko: 나의 진짜 잠재력은 아직 발휘되지 않은 걸까?
questions.text_en: Has my true potential not yet been realized?
questions.text_es: ¿Todavía no se ha realizado mi verdadero potencial?

questions.text_ko: 나는 나만의 속도로 나아가고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Am I moving forward at my own pace?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy avanzando a mi propio ritmo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 무엇을 위해 살아가고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What am I living for?
questions.text_es: ¿Para qué estoy viviendo?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 진짜 행복은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What does real happiness mean for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué significa la felicidad real para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 옳은 방향으로 나아가고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I moving in the right direction right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy avanzando en la dirección correcta ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인생에서 가장 중요한 가치는 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's the most important value in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es el valor más importante en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 삶에 만족하고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I satisfied with my life right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy satisfecho/a con mi vida ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 무엇을 할 때 가장 살아있다고 느낄까?
questions.text_en: When do I feel most alive?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo me siento más vivo/a?

questions.text_ko: 나의 삶의 목적은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's my life's purpose?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es el propósito de mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 삶의 어느 단계에 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: What stage of life am I in right now?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué etapa de la vida estoy ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 무엇을 놓치고 살아가고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What am I missing out on in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué me estoy perdiendo en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인생에서 진짜 중요한 것은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's truly important in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué es verdaderamente importante en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 나 자신에게 솔직하게 살고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I living honestly with myself right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy viviendo honestamente conmigo mismo/a ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 삶을 살아야 후회가 없을까?
questions.text_en: What kind of life would leave me without regrets?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de vida me dejaría sin arrepentimientos?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 지금 필요한 변화는 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What change do I need right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué cambio necesito ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 남들의 기준과 나의 기준 중 무엇을 따라야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I follow others' standards, or my own?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería seguir los estándares de otros, o los míos propios?

questions.text_ko: 나의 인생에서 가장 의미 있는 순간은 언제였을까, 혹은 언제일까?
questions.text_en: When was — or will be — the most meaningful moment of my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo fue, o será, el momento más significativo de mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 불안을 어떻게 다루어야 할까?
questions.text_en: How should I handle the anxiety I'm feeling right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo debería manejar la ansiedad que siento ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 인생의 큰 그림은 어떤 모습일까?
questions.text_en: What does the big picture of my life look like?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo se ve el panorama general de mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 나답게 살고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Am I living true to myself right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy viviendo fiel a mí mismo/a ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나의 삶에서 반복되는 고민의 뿌리는 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's at the root of the worry that keeps recurring in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué hay en la raíz de la preocupación que se repite en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 앞으로 어떤 사람으로 성장하게 될까?
questions.text_en: What kind of person will I grow into going forward?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué tipo de persona voy a convertirme de aquí en adelante?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 가장 중요한 시기는 언제일까?
questions.text_en: When is the most important period for me this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo es el período más importante para mí este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나는 어떤 흐름을 타게 될까?
questions.text_en: What kind of flow will I be in this year?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué tipo de flujo estaré este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 조심해야 할 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period I should be careful during this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período del que debería tener cuidado este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 좋은 기회가 찾아올까?
questions.text_en: Will a good opportunity come my way this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me presentará una buena oportunidad este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나의 전반적인 운의 흐름은 어떨까?
questions.text_en: What's the overall flow of my luck this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es el flujo general de mi suerte este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 중요한 만남이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Will I have an important encounter this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Tendré un encuentro importante este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나는 어떤 부분에 집중해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I focus on this year?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué debería enfocarme este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 변화가 필요한 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a part of my life that needs to change this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una parte de mi vida que necesita cambiar este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 하반기 나의 흐름은 어떻게 달라질까?
questions.text_en: How will my flow shift in the second half of this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo cambiará mi flujo en la segunda mitad de este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 뜻밖의 일이 생길 가능성이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a chance something unexpected happens to me this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una posibilidad de que me pase algo inesperado este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나는 무엇을 내려놓아야 할까?
questions.text_en: What do I need to let go of this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué necesito soltar este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 힘든 시기가 지나가고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is a difficult period passing for me this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Está pasando un período difícil para mí este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나의 노력이 결실을 맺을 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can my efforts pay off this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Pueden dar frutos mis esfuerzos este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 중요한 결정을 내려야 할 순간이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a moment this year when I'll have to make an important decision?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un momento este año en que tendré que tomar una decisión importante?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나는 어떤 사람들과 인연이 닿게 될까?
questions.text_en: What kind of people will I connect with this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Con qué tipo de personas voy a conectar este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 휴식이 필요한 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period this year when I'll need rest?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período este año en el que voy a necesitar descanso?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나의 에너지가 가장 강한 시기는 언제일까?
questions.text_en: When is my energy at its strongest this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo está mi energía en su punto más fuerte este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나는 어떤 것을 새로 시작하기에 좋을까?
questions.text_en: What's a good thing for me to start fresh this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué es algo bueno para que empiece de nuevo este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나에게 마무리해야 할 일이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something I need to wrap up this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo que necesito terminar este año?

questions.text_ko: 올해 나의 전체적인 방향은 어디를 향하고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Where is my overall direction headed this year?
questions.text_es: ¿Hacia dónde se dirige mi dirección general este año?

questions.text_ko: 지금 이 결정을 내려도 괜찮은 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Is this an okay time to make this decision?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este un buen momento para tomar esta decisión?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 선택을 서두르는 게 좋을까, 미루는 게 좋을까?
questions.text_en: Should I rush this choice, or put it off?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería apresurar esta decisión, o posponerla?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 중요한 결정을 내리기 좋은 시기가 따로 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a particular time that's good for me to make important decisions?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un momento en particular que sea bueno para que tome decisiones importantes?

questions.text_ko: 지금 고민 중인 이 일을 시작해도 될까?
questions.text_en: Is it okay for me to start the thing I'm currently considering?
questions.text_es: ¿Está bien que empiece lo que estoy considerando ahora?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 갈림길에서 어떤 선택을 해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What choice should I make at this crossroads?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué decisión debería tomar en esta encrucijada?

questions.text_ko: 지금 이 기회를 놓치면 다시 오지 않을까?
questions.text_en: If I miss this opportunity now, will it not come again?
questions.text_es: Si dejo pasar esta oportunidad ahora, ¿no volverá a presentarse?

questions.text_ko: 나는 신중해야 할 때와 과감해야 할 때를 잘 구분하고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I good at telling when to be cautious and when to be bold?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me da bien distinguir cuándo ser cauteloso/a y cuándo ser audaz?

questions.text_ko: 지금의 망설임에는 이유가 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Is there a reason behind my hesitation right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una razón detrás de mi duda ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 결정을 누구와 상의해야 할까?
questions.text_en: Who should I discuss this decision with?
questions.text_es: ¿Con quién debería discutir esta decisión?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 지금 필요한 건 결단력일까, 인내심일까?
questions.text_en: What do I need right now — decisiveness, or patience?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué necesito ahora mismo: decisión, o paciencia?

questions.text_ko: 이 선택이 나중에 후회로 남지 않을까?
questions.text_en: Will this choice end up as a regret later?
questions.text_es: ¿Terminará siendo esta decisión un arrepentimiento más adelante?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 직감을 믿어도 될까?
questions.text_en: Is it okay for me to trust my gut right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Está bien que confíe en mi instinto ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 다시 생각해봐야 할 결정이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a decision I need to reconsider?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una decisión que necesito reconsiderar?

questions.text_ko: 지금 이 타이밍에 변화를 주는 게 맞을까?
questions.text_en: Is now the right timing to make a change?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este el momento correcto para hacer un cambio?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 결정을 내리기에 아직 준비가 안 된 걸까?
questions.text_en: Am I just not ready yet to make this decision?
questions.text_es: ¿Simplemente no estoy listo/a todavía para tomar esta decisión?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 결정적인 신호가 나타날 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a period ahead when a decisive sign will appear for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un período por delante en el que me aparecerá una señal decisiva?

questions.text_ko: 지금 포기하려는 이 일, 정말 그만두어도 될까?
questions.text_en: This thing I'm about to give up on — should I really quit it?
questions.text_es: Esto que estoy a punto de abandonar, ¿debería realmente dejarlo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 선택으로 어떤 미래를 맞이하게 될까?
questions.text_en: What kind of future will this choice lead me to?
questions.text_es: ¿A qué tipo de futuro me llevará esta decisión?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 지금 가장 중요한 우선순위는 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's my most important priority right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi prioridad más importante ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 결정을 나 자신을 위해 내리고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Am I making this decision for myself?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy tomando esta decisión por mí mismo/a?

questions.text_ko: 지금이 이사하기에 좋은 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Is now a good time to move?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este un buen momento para mudarme?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금 사는 곳을 떠나야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I leave the place where I'm living now?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería dejar el lugar donde vivo ahora?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 더 잘 맞는 곳은 어디일까?
questions.text_en: Where would be a better place for me?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál sería un mejor lugar para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 새로운 환경에서 더 잘 지낼 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Would I do better living in a new environment?
questions.text_es: ¿Me iría mejor viviendo en un ambiente nuevo?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 낯선 곳으로 떠나는 게 좋은 선택일까?
questions.text_en: Would it be a good choice for me to move somewhere unfamiliar?
questions.text_es: ¿Sería una buena decisión para mí mudarme a un lugar desconocido?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 익숙함을 벗어나야 할 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Is it time for me to step out of my current comfort zone?
questions.text_es: ¿Es hora de que salga de mi zona de confort actual?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 환경의 변화가 필요한 이유가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a reason I need a change of environment?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una razón por la que necesito un cambio de ambiente?

questions.text_ko: 나는 새로운 도시나 나라에서 살아도 잘 적응할까?
questions.text_en: Would I adjust well living in a new city or country?
questions.text_es: ¿Me adaptaría bien viviendo en una ciudad o país nuevo?

questions.text_ko: 나의 삶에서 큰 변화가 다가오고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is a big change coming in my life?
questions.text_es: ¿Se acerca un gran cambio en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 안정을 유지하는 게 좋을까, 변화를 주는 게 좋을까?
questions.text_en: Is it better for me to keep my current stability, or make a change?
questions.text_es: ¿Es mejor para mí mantener mi estabilidad actual, o hacer un cambio?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 새로운 시작이 필요한 시기가 왔을까?
questions.text_en: Has a time come when I need a fresh start?
questions.text_es: ¿Ha llegado un momento en que necesito un nuevo comienzo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 익숙한 곳을 떠나는 것에 대한 두려움을 어떻게 다뤄야 할까?
questions.text_en: How should I handle my fear of leaving a familiar place?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo debería manejar mi miedo a dejar un lugar familiar?

questions.text_ko: 나의 생활 방식에 변화가 필요한 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a part of my lifestyle that needs to change?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una parte de mi estilo de vida que necesita cambiar?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 루틴에서 벗어나야 할까?
questions.text_en: Should I break away from my current routine?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería romper con mi rutina actual?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 새로운 공간이 주는 에너지가 필요할까?
questions.text_en: Do I need the energy that a new space could bring me?
questions.text_es: ¿Necesito la energía que un espacio nuevo podría darme?

questions.text_ko: 나는 변화를 받아들일 준비가 되어 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I ready to embrace change?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy listo/a para aceptar el cambio?

questions.text_ko: 나의 삶에서 다음 챕터는 어떤 모습일까?
questions.text_en: What will the next chapter of my life look like?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo se verá el próximo capítulo de mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 지금의 삶에서 무엇을 바꾸고 싶어 할까?
questions.text_en: What do I want to change about my life right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué quiero cambiar de mi vida ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 환경을 바꾸면 좋아질 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something that would improve if I changed my environment?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo que mejoraría si cambiara de ambiente?

questions.text_ko: 나는 변화 이후에 더 나은 삶을 살게 될까?
questions.text_en: Will I live a better life after this change?
questions.text_es: ¿Viviré una vida mejor después de este cambio?

questions.text_ko: 나는 요즘 왜 이렇게 쉽게 지칠까?
questions.text_en: Why do I get tired so easily these days?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me canso tan fácilmente estos días?

questions.text_ko: 나의 에너지가 가장 좋은 시간대나 계절은 언제일까?
questions.text_en: What time of day or season is my energy at its best?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué momento del día o estación está mi energía en su mejor punto?

questions.text_ko: 나는 충분히 쉬고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Am I getting enough rest?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy descansando lo suficiente?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 지금 휴식이 필요한 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Is now a period when I need rest?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este un período en el que necesito descanso?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 방식으로 에너지를 충전하는 사람일까?
questions.text_en: In what way do I tend to recharge my energy?
questions.text_es: ¿De qué manera tiendo a recargar mi energía?

questions.text_ko: 나의 컨디션이 자주 떨어지는 이유가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a reason my condition drops so often?
